confirmedSourceGap.trigger: Short catalog or tall available window: Scroll viewport height exceeds natural detail content height.
confirmedSourceGap.numericExample: Width352,1chapter:content516.313vp; width720,1chapter:494.875vp. Center adds (viewport-content)/2 above intended8vp top gap when positive.
confirmedSourceGap.tests: test-bookshelf-physical-feedback.mjs verifies chapter preview0/3/20/40 counts and height, but does not instantiate detailScroll or assert Scroll.align. test-phone-layout-figma-regressions.mjs verifies detail width/frame/button sizing only.
confirmedSourceGap.pixelBoundary: No native layout, VM screenshot, physical-device or user-acceptance test this audit.

risksOnly.risk: 112vp fixed bottom padding remains while77vp actionArea is separate normal-flow sibling; possible legacy overlay clearance. Design intent not established, not declared bug.
116vp bottom padding remains with normal-flow MainTabBar; trailing whitespace/short viewport scroll possible. Figma intent unverified, not declared bug.
Zero-catalog height fixed282vp vs1chapter108vp; large empty card may be intended, current test explicitly retains282vp.
Empty-search illustration/action surface uses defaultcenter plus50top/40bottom. Distinct from list/history; Figma/intent not audited so not confirmed defect.
Reading failure overlay uses body rect/defaultcenter. Existing test covers rect/action callbacks; centering may be intended, not confirmed defect.

excludedReasons: 21 vertical Scrolls explicitlyTop/TopStart, including currently fixedBookshelfEmpty and Search history/sourceRequired/sourceLoadError.
4 horizontal Scrolls do not produce the vertical-center mechanism.
Remaining unaligned containers include fixed/morphing reader control panels, search panels, measured modal bodies/menu, and diagnostic-onlypage; did not treat lack ofalign as defect.

Index consumes App safeTop once; AppTopBar/PageBackBar do not add another. MainTabShell rail uses host-local coordinates and has regression. SourceSwitchWindow uses consumeTopInset=false in App route and own inset only for edge-to-edgeReader context.

Negative local regression results do not imply every native pixel symptom reproduced.
